boundary: This is a local contract and migration-readiness snapshot. It is not a live MCP connection, hosted AgentTeams receipt, vendor SLA, or production approval.

same canonical result digest for a replay fixture
typed timeout/auth/schema errors map to fail-closed or DEFER
no credentials or raw sensitive payloads in the trace
source_basis: local allowlist and typed ToolTrace contract
